test_title: PYST 48: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The solution is **Disipline**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The INCORRECTLY spelt word is Disipline. 
 
• The correct spelt word is **discipline**. 
 
• Discipline is the practice of training people to obey rules or a code of behaviour, using punishment to correct disobedience.
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss about other options:
 
 
• **Assembly - **A group of people gathered together in one place for a common purpose.
 
• **Group - **A number of people or things that are located, gathered, or classed together.
 
• **Leader - **The person who leads or commands a group, organization, or country.
